notes.title: Full Release of Coloring Game: Studio
notes.notes:
[b]Coloring Game: Studio[/b] is out of Early Access.

You have access to 150 pictures (3,600,000 px). 
Ability to upload and edit pictures.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231040/Coloring_Game_Studio/

notes.title: Update 2.4.5
notes.notes:
The game now features the lazy coloring mode that doesn’t involve the left mouse button. On activating this mode, the program automatically blocks the previously colored pixels.

notes.title: Update 2.4.3
Season Pass Update
notes.notes:
The majority of players have supported us by purchasing the [b]Season Pass[/b] right at the start of its sales (70% of the total sales of DLCs for CG3). As a compliment from the developer, we have decided to adjust the initial plan by releasing final images from the upcoming DLC (Art Museum) right now. 

[list]
[*] This DLC contains 6 images with the total volume being 528,200 px (out of 1,515,700 px).
[*] Another 400,000 px image is going to be added between August 14 and August 21. [b]UPD: Added.[/b]
[*] The last three images are going to be added on August 26 (587,500 px).
[*] The [b]Art Museum[/b] DLC will be available for purchase on August 28.
[/list]

Please note that the Art Museum is not going to feature animation for completed images. The majority of images represent highly dynamic scenes, while the animation of eyes and other small parts of the images has failed to produce positive results. That is why we have decided to make an exception and not to add animation to this DLC. I hope for the players’ understanding on this matter.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1362600/Coloring_Game_3__Season_Pass/
